remove.title: Delete this conversation?
remove.body: The conversation and its queue are deleted, and any running work is canceled. Run history is kept.

newDialog.title: New chat
newDialog.titleHelp: If empty, it's set from the first message.

switchTeam.title: Change team
switchTeam.confirmBody: Sessions of nodes missing from the new team aren't continued. Nodes that stay carry over their earlier context.
switchTeam.blocked: You can change it after the run finishes

header.teamTooltip: Editing this team applies from the next turn, and sessions of removed nodes are dropped.
header.waitingChipHint: Go to the oldest card waiting for you
header.toggleListLabel: Show or hide the conversation list

empty.selectOrStart: Select a conversation or start a new one
empty.selectOrStartBody: Pick a conversation from the list on the left, or choose a team to start a new chat.

composer.backendBadgeNote: Running on the {badge} backend. Change the backend to use a real model.
composer.noEntryBanner: This team has no user message entry, so you can't start a chat.
composer.noAnswerBanner: This team has no reply edge, so results won't appear in the chat.
composer.teamDeleted: This conversation's team was deleted. You can still read the history. To start a new chat with the same name, create the team in the team list.
composer.runsBlocked: The runs integration is off, so you can't send messages in this conversation
composer.rejectBusy: You can send after the previous work finishes. (Setting: don't accept new messages while running)
composer.queued_one: It continues after the earlier work finishes ({count} waiting)
composer.queued_other: It continues after the earlier work finishes ({count} waiting)

answer.placeholderCard: New message (answer the question in the card above)
answer.placeholderCards_one: New message (answer the waiting question in its card)
answer.placeholderCards_other: New message (answer the {count} waiting questions in their cards)
answer.movedToCard: The reply field moved to the card. Text in the message box is sent as a new message.
answer.movedToComposer: The reply field moved to the message box.

held.banner_one: The server restarted, so {count} queued item is on hold.
held.banner_other: The server restarted, so {count} queued items are on hold.
held.disconnected: Can't process it because the connection dropped

session.title: This app has no session history for this conversation
session.body: You can read the conversation. To keep sending, continue in a new session without the earlier context, or start a new chat.
session.bodyPartial_one: You can read the conversation. If you keep sending, only {count} node without context starts a new session. You can also start a new chat.
session.bodyPartial_other: You can read the conversation. If you keep sending, only the {count} nodes without context start new sessions. You can also start a new chat.
session.armed: The next message starts a new session without the earlier context.
session.blocked: Can't send because the session history is missing. Choose an option above
session.relocatable: The project folder path changed, so the session history is moved before continuing.
session.archived: Continues from the session history archived in this folder.
session.archivedTurn: Continues from the session history archived in this folder
session.freshStarted: Started a new session without the earlier context

state.archived: Resumes from the folder's archived copy

resume.interruptedBanner: The server restarted or stopped, so this turn was interrupted.
resume.title: Rerun from here
resume.intro: Reruns the node you pick with its saved input, then continues below it as usual.
resume.loading: Loading the points you can rerun
resume.loadFailed: Couldn't load the points to rerun
resume.notRerunnableReason: This node type can't be rerun
resume.costWarning: Rerunning a node that was running may increase usage
resume.upstreamNote: Nodes above the one you pick are marked “Skipped (resumed)”

turn.stopConfirmBody_one: {count} request waiting for a reply is canceled.
turn.stopConfirmBody_other: {count} requests waiting for a reply are canceled.

interaction.waitingLiveAnon: A request is waiting for a reply
